translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: Colosenses
book.title: Colosasgi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Garda Narmaksad Colosenses

content: Ar bemar nue wisgubi an abedo, an bemargala nue-dummad alamaknaid, degine, Laodiceagi-bukmaladga, deginbali, bela dulemar amba-yo-an-wagar-dakmaladga, an nue alamaknaibalid.

An alamaknaido, adi bemar-burba gangumalagar, sabguedgine nue-bulakwaa nanamalagar, degine, belagwapa mag-itogedgine, nuekwaa Bab-Dummad-igar-dukuar-maigusad wisguegar, ar we-igar-dukuar-maigusad, we Cristo-sunnaddo.
Ar bela ibmar-wisi-guedi, degine, ibmar-mag-ito-guedi, ar unnila Cristoginbi maid.
Ar we an bemarga sogdo, adi mer dulemar yamo-binsaed-nikaa yeer-sunmakdimaladse be yardaklemalagar.

Ar an bemar-abargi sanagwar gudisurmar-inigwele, an bemar-abargi-gudiyob be angi binsamaloed. Deginbali, an weligwar itodo, ar an wisid bemar nued nanadimalad, degine, Cristogi nue-bensuli bemar nanadimarbalid.
Degisoggu, ar igi bemar Bab-Jesucristo be-Dummadga be abingasmala, amba deyob bemar egi-akani gudigue-wilubmarbardo.
Degine, gatik bur-bule be-burba-maligan Cristogi diglemar, degine, Cristogi be bensulidba, gatik egi be gandik gwisgumarsun. Ar be odurdaklesmaladyob, Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye sogdigu bemar gumarsun.
Cristoginbi igar-napiragwad danikid

Degisoggu, nue salakarmar. Mer dulemar-binsa-na-ibmar-wisi-sogdimaladse binsaed galemalo, ar wemar unnila dulemar-igar-maidba, degine, we-napneg-igar-maidba sunmakdimalad, Cristo-igar-maidba sunmakdisurmalad.
Ar igar-napiragwaddi Cristoginbi danikid. Ar bela Bab-Dummad-e-burba, degine, Bab-Dummad-binsaed, bela Cristo na e-sangi deyob nikmogad.

Cristo bela burbar-dummaganga-gumaid, degine, burbar-gandikidba-gangued-nikmalad e-dummadid. A-Cristogi bemar akanaid, degisoggu, bemar unnitiba Bab Dummad igi nanabi bemar-abemaid Cristogi nikmarsunnad.

Deginbali, ar bemar Cristogi akanimarsoggu, bemar Cristogadga gunonisunnad. Cristogadga bemar gunonikid, abgan-duku-sikaled-ular sur, ar unnila adi sangi wilub nagued. Suli, agarsuli. Iskuedgi Cristo bemar-abonosad-ular, bemar Cristogadga gunonikid.

Ar bemar Bab Dummad na e-ganguedgi gannar Cristo-odulosadgi bengussurmarsoggu, bemar Bab-Jesús-digi-ogleged-igar imaksamargu, Cristoba napa-urba diglesayob gunonimalad, degine, eba gannar bemar durgusmalayob gunonimarbalid.
Ar iduardi be iskudiid-ular bemar burbar burgwar gudigusanad, deun yo bemar Cristogadga gumargu. Emigindi Cristoba-mesa Bab Dummad bemarga burba-dulad uksasunnad, bemarga be-iskudimalad osulononigu.

Igar-maidgi anmar annadigusad-ular, we-igar-maid anmarga sognaisunnad, anmarde sabsur odurdaklegoye. Degi-odurdaklegoed-igar-maid Bab Dummad anmarga osulononikid, deun Cristo nakrusgi burgwenonigu. We-igar dule-burgwisadyob gunonisunnad, degisoggu, we-igar geg bar-anmar-oakalosundo.
Cristo nakrusgi burgwisgu, bela burbar-dummaganga-gumaid, degine, burbar-gandikidba-gangued-nikmaladgi nakwisad, degine, Cristo ibgwensur emar-wagab amar-imaksabalid.
Degisoggu, dulemar mer begi sunmaked be sao, be-ibmar-gunnedgi, be-gobedgi, be-ibagan-dakedgi, nii-gwagedgi, degine, be-obunnoged-ibagi.
Ar unnila wemar belagwapa yo-ibmar-danikoed-e-burbagan gued, ar Cristodi napiragwad gued. Cristo napnegse-nonikidba we-igar osanalononikid.

Bab-neggi-be-ibmar-nued-maid mer emar begi sued be imakmalo. Dulemar yamo-na-san-bipii-imakdimaladse, degine, angermar-nug-odummoged-Bab-Dummadyob-imakmaladse mer be yardaklemalo. Ar amardi ibmar-daksasuli binsa gordiid, na dukin binsa san-odummodiid.

Ar Cristo eba-akananaimalad-e-nonoga gusisoggu, a bela san-odummogega gued, bela egi-akananaimalad-odungusunnad, Bab Dummad igar-mesisadbar. Ar we-dulemardi Cristogi gwen akanaisurmarsoggu, noar dulemar-odurdakdimalad.
Nibneggined-ibmarmar bur be amimar
Ar bemar Cristoba burgwismarsoggu, we-napneg-naid-e-binsaedba be burgwismardo, ar degite, ¿ibiga amba we-napnegginedyob be damala? ¿Ibiga we-napneggined igar-sogedba be damarsunna?
Ar emide we-dulemar bemarga soggu: “We melle be ebugo, melle be gunno, amba be-argangi ebugedse-bakar mer be ebubalo.”
Ar we-ibmargandi ebugedba bergudoed, ar ade unnila dulemar-sogedba, degine, dulemar igar-odurdakedba odurdakdimalad. Degisoggu, mer amar-odurdakedba be damar.

Ar napiragwad, we-ibmar igar-nuedyob dakleged, ar ade Bab-Dummadse-goled-maid na emar mesisad, na san-bipii-saed, degine, sabsur na-san-saed, ar degi-inigwele, we-ibmarmar iskuedgi geg-anmar-bargamalad.
